note: King Lake northeast of King City. The main camping spot is a gravel loop in open woods on the east shore, reached by a short gravel track north from the boat-ramp lot off NW Ridgeline Road. A second designated spot is beside a small gravel lot on NW Berlin Road at the north end. No amenities. --Claude
